visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person opens a large white woven bag filled with thick logs of wood. The scene cuts to hands placing these logs onto a metal grill over a glowing charcoal bed, where smoke and small flames are visible. (2) Hands hold up two black octagonal bento boxes filled with white rice, grilled meat, broccoli, tofu, and other colorful vegetables. The camera then focuses on tongs flipping marinated meat over an open flame with bright orange sparks. (3) A close-up shows sauce being poured from a squeeze bottle onto a pile of grilled beef slices in a bento box. Chopsticks lift several slices of the beef, showing the glistening sauce and texture. (4) The camera pans across three different bento boxes. Chopsticks then lift a piece of bright green broccoli, followed by a golden-brown fried dumpling from the box. (5) A new bento box with grilled chicken thigh topped with sesame seeds is shown. Chopsticks pull apart a juicy piece of the chicken. (6) Another box with white chicken breast and a green basil sauce is presented; a piece is dipped into the sauce and lifted. (7) King oyster mushrooms are tossed in a metal basket over a high flame. A small white tray of the grilled mushrooms and another tray of golden potato wedges with garlic bits are shown. (8) The interior of the shop is revealed, showing a clean, narrow wooden counter with high stools. (9) The exterior of the shop '森 炭 WOODED COAL' is shown with a white facade and a wooden door.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A female narrator begins speaking in an energetic and inviting tone over an upbeat, major-key pop track. A prominent crackling and sizzling sound of burning wood is heard as the visuals show the grill. (2) The voice maintains a high pitch and rapid pace as she describes the beef bento. A subtle 'ding' sound effect highlights the presentation of the meat. (3) The rhythmic background music, featuring electronic drums and a clean synth melody, continues without interruption. The narrator's speech is dense, with very few pauses. (4) As the chicken dishes are introduced, the narrator's volume increases slightly for emphasis. The ambient sound of the grill sizzle reappears briefly. (5) The narration concludes with a warm invitation to visit, while the music maintains its tempo before fading out alongside the narrator's final words.
